description: This Java source file defines the 'CameraPreview' class that manages the display of a camera preview in an Android application. It handles surface lifecycle events, sets up the camera preview display, and calculates the correct display orientation for the camera feed.

classes.name: CameraPreview
classes.description: A custom SurfaceView that displays camera preview frames. Manages surface lifecycle callbacks and updates the camera display appropriately.

methods.name: CameraPreview
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CameraPreview with context, camera object, camera info, and display orientation.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Callback invoked when the surface is created; sets the camera preview display.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the surface is destroyed; placeholder for releasing camera resources.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the surface changes; restarts the camera preview with correct orientation.

methods.name: calculatePreviewOrientation
methods.description: Static utility method to compute the correct camera preview orientation based on device rotation and camera info.
